title: Tropical Depression Nineteen-E (EP4), advisory 01/0231Z
summary: DEPRESSION BARELY A TROPICAL CYCLONE. As of 8:00 PM PDT Wed Sep 30 the center of Nineteen-E was located near 15.2, -125.9 with movement ENE at 14 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.
